The Sovereign Ledger

Asset Class Overview

SME Funds

Strategic capital deployment for Small and Medium Enterprises poised for institutional transition and public listing.

Growth Capital for Small Businesses

SME Funds represent the bridge between private resilience and public market maturity. By providing equity financing to high-growth MSMEs, we catalyze operational scaling and corporate governance improvements.

Strategic Parameters

Key Characteristics

storefront
MSME Focus

Concentrated exposure to sectors with high domestic demand and export potential, specifically targeting enterprises with turnover between $5M and $50M.

handshake
Sponsor Commitment

Alignment of interest through significant general partner (GP) commitment, ensuring rigorous due diligence and post-investment stewardship.

The Fund Lifecycle

The path to institutional realization

01

Sourcing

Proprietary network access to off-market SME opportunities with strong cash flows and scalable unit economics.

02

Growth

Active management involvement to institutionalize governance, digitize operations, and expand market footprint.

03

Listing/Exit

Strategic exits via IPOs on specialized SME exchanges or secondary acquisitions by larger private equity firms.

trending_up

High Return Potential

Emerging leaders in the SME space often trade at significant discounts to large-cap peers. Our strategy captures this "arbitrage of scale" as companies mature.

Targeted IRR
18% — 24%
